roles.S_author: Seek errors. Produce a claim/premise/use table from the common packet.
roles.S_critic: Independently audit the authored table against source records, seeking errors.
roles.S_defender: Independently revise the audit against the same records; seek errors.
roles.VE_author: Defend the proposed argument, faithfully formalising uses and premises. Return JSON with environment (VE core@0 environment), claims [{id,source: strict VE}], edges [{id,premises,conclusion}], root, alignment {node_id:[record_ids]}, queries:[], splits:[]. Include every shared node and all six declared premises. Author your own formalisation; no undeclared bridge may become a free premise. Local certificate search is charged. For a split, return a complete new environment and all affected claims, and splits [{old_symbol,new_symbols,affected_ids,divergent_uses}]. All old certificates are voided. Queries may use compare or validate_attack with tool, claim_id, environment_id, committed_source, record_id, rival_source_text (exact record), rival_ve. At most four queries and four splits total.

roles.X_author: Defend the proposed argument. Return JSON {"commitment":"fixed meanings, at most 512 tokens","argument":"defense"}.
roles.X_critic: Seek source-grounded flaws across branches. Return JSON {"questions":[up to three self-contained questions, each <=256 tokens]}.
roles.answer: Answer only this question using the unchanged packet and frozen commitment. You are an isolated proposer copy.
roles.followup: Inspect the initial questions and answers for inconsistency. Return JSON {"question":"one self-contained adaptive question <=256 tokens, or empty"}. Do not transmit other copies’ full answers.
roles.judge: Return exactly a JSON verdict conforming to the response schema. Assess original justification, cite source evidence.
roles.paraphrase: Independently rewrite the proposed argument as node texts into ordinary prose. Preserve substantive content and any inconsistency; do not repair it. Return JSON {"texts":{"node_id":"rewritten node text"}}. Include every existing node ID exactly once. No additional fields.
roles.repair: Repair only the diagnosed syntax/coverage failures. One repair is allowed; retain the original root. system: Audit the ORIGINAL justification from the dossier. Glossary senses are possibilities; records anchor uses. Approve only a supported original root. Reject unsupported justification without asserting the root false. Unknown is allowed. Cite at most two node IDs. A conditional proof or DIFFERENT does not establish source fidelity.
